//: The guard this file exists for is the naming convention — see the shared-vocabulary block at the top of the pieces section in src/index.css.

stylelint-config-standard's formatting opinions are deliberately not adopted: index.css sets compact one-line rules on purpose, and reformatting ~1700 lines to one declaration each would cost its readability and gain nothing.

declaration-block-no-duplicate-properties allows consecutive duplicates with different values, because `height: 100%; height: 100dvh` and the min(88vh)/min(88dvh) pairs are deliberate fallbacks for engines without dvh. Collapsing them would silently drop the fallback.

selector-class-pattern.message: Class names are kebab-case: either a shared shape (badge, row, chip) or <section>-<thing> (sheet-frame, attack-roll-key). See the shared-vocabulary block in index.css.
